newsitem.title: UK: Tradepoint trade rises sharply in H1.
newsitem.headline: Tradepoint trade rises sharply in H1.

text.p: Tradepoint Investment Exchange, the main rival to the London Stock Exchange, said on Thursday that total traded value increased 165 percent to 418.0 million stg in the first half.
Total traded volume in the six months to June grew by 242 percent to 126.5 million shares.
"Institutions, market makers and brokers are now increasingly trading on the UK's only electronic market and are consistently able to deal at better prices," the company said in a statement.
Tradepoint is owned by Tradepoint Financial Networks Plc. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
